should_trigger: set up supermodo in this project
can you bootstrap supermodo for this repo
another skill says skills.config.json is missing or invalid
add the mutation command to the config
onboard this project onto the supermodo skills
upgrade my skills.config.json to the new version
should_not_trigger: set up eslint in this project
change the coverage settings in vitest.config.ts
what does skills.config.json do in the nx monorepo?
write a config parser in typescript
add a Makefile target for tests

behavior.setup: Repo with Makefile (test/lint/coverage targets), docs/ without README.md, no .claude/agents, no skills.config.json.
assert: First interview message contains exactly ONE 'Step N of M' block — never two or more questions
No question mentions GitLab, GitHub, CI, or deployment
M announced at step 1
Does not invite 'all defaults' or 'answer per-item'

behavior.setup: Same repo; no mutation tool anywhere.
assert: Missing tiers (mutation, testUnit, testAll) each get the 3-option menu: set up after / give command now / skip
No tier is described as 'none found — omit'
No discovered command is executed before the user approves its argv

behavior.setup: Repo with source files and tests, no agents dir.
assert: Concrete roles proposed immediately (filename + one-line each), grounded in the project stack
Exactly one yes/no follows the proposal, default no
Does NOT skip to single-agent fallback and does NOT ask permission to propose

behavior.setup: Repo with source files and tests, no agents dir; user accepts the proposed roles and says they use both Claude Code and Codex.
behavior.prompt: /supermodo:config — agent-team step, accept proposal, choose both hosts
assert: agents.dir written once (canonical, current host's native dir by default)
agents.hosts contains both host slugs
Mirroring routed to /supermodo:sync-configs — config itself writes role files only into the canonical dir
No second roster dir created by config

behavior.setup: Empty folder with only .git/ and a stub README.md.
assert: No interview — fast path taken
No commands invented or recorded
Report includes the settings table and the /supermodo:commit pointer
Only new files created; no pre-existing file modified without confirmation
Shows config + validation result and offers edits
Does NOT re-run the bootstrap or propose re-scaffolding
